calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, s.store_id = 999 AS is_train,
  count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_rl,
  sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1,
  count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test,
  count(*) AS n, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
  sum(round(f.net_amount * (1 + f.vat_rate), 2)) AS recomputed_gross,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount * (1 + f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_mismatch,
  min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross_incl_vat, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_excl_vat, count(*) AS n
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) AS m, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_net_before_returns, count(DISTINCT business_date) AS days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id < 900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT mine.*, ctl.ctl_net_before_returns, ctl.days, mine.net_excl_vat - ctl.ctl_net_before_returns AS gap
FROM mine JOIN ctl USING (m) ORDER BY m
